ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: On the left of the figure is a benzene ring, and on the right is connected a nitrogen-containing cyclic/transition-state structure; a N-H, an O-H positively charged carbonyl-oxygen-related fragment, and several curved arrows are visible. The problem requires ignoring hydrogen-related bonds and arrows. Then reason: Count bond by bond according to the specified method; the intraring bonds between the six heavy atoms of the benzene ring count as 6. The bonds outside the benzene ring that do not contain hydrogen include: an aryl C-N bond, an N-C bond, the C-C bond on the right, the C-C bond connected to the carbonyl carbon, and the C=O bond, totaling 5. The total is 6 + 5 = 11.

raw_record.question_text: In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen. Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Scan the drawing bond by bond. Count the six heavy-atom bonds forming the benzene ring. Then count the non-hydrogen bonds outside the benzene ring: aryl C-N, N-C, C-C along the right side, C-C to the carbonyl carbon, and the C=O bond. Do not count N-H, O-H, or any curved arrows. Sum 6 + 5 = 11.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中左侧是一个苯环，右侧连接含氮的环状/过渡态结构；可见一个 N-H、一个 O-H 带正电的羰基氧相关片段，以及若干弯曲箭头。题目要求忽略氢相关键和箭头。再推理：按指定方法逐键计数，苯环的六个重原子之间的环内键计为 6 个。苯环外不含氢的键包括：芳基 C-N 键、N-C 键、右侧的 C-C 键、连接到羰基碳的 C-C 键，以及 C=O 键，共 5 个。总数为 6 + 5 = 11。
